text:
maria: Heads up — noticed a +4% token delta on yesterday's invoices after the routing rollout. Looks correlated with the new multi-model fanout + retry policy.
kevin: ugh. is that double-counting from retries or real extra tokens from fallbacks?
sam: initial glance: events show same reqid, two meter events with different route tags. one to primary model pool, one to fallback dedicated pool.
ellie: can you paste a sample event?
maria: sure — here's the minimal envelope we saw in S3 (sanitized):
```
{"req_id":"r-9a1","route":"route-alpha","model":"open-7b","tokens":26,"fingerprint":"fp-xyz"}
{"req_id":"r-9a1","route":"route-alpha","model":"open-7b-fallback","tokens":26,"fingerprint":"fp-xyz"}
```
both emitted within 200ms of each other.
raj: that smells like our route fallback path emitting a separate metering event instead of associating as a retry. the fallback should be counted as the final attribution only.
tess: which component emits the second event? fallback proxy or the consumer service?
maria: appears to be coming from the routing sidecar (route-resolver v2) which now emits an audit event on fallback + the runtime also emits a metering event when it actually serves.
kevin: we added that audit emit to improve observability — but forgot to mark it as non-billable. oops.
sam: quick mitigation: treat audit_event=true as non-billable in the metering ingestion for the next 24h. can we patch fast?
ellie: we can add a filter in the streaming-ingest lambda: if event.source=="route-resolver" and event.type=="fallback_audit" then drop for billing pipeline. but we should still keep it for console traceability.
raj: agree. but need to ensure we don't drop legitimate multi-model fanout where two different models actually served tokens.
maria: good point. audit events include "served":false usually. real model responses have served:true + response.tokens > 0.
tess: so ingestion rule: drop when source==route-resolver AND fallback_audit==true OR when served==false and duplicate fingerprint exists within 1s. complicated but doable.
kevin: patch + hotfix to streaming-ingest in staging now. deploy window in 10.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled by kevin at 2026-03-23T15:10Z to streaming-ingest/staging :rocket:
maria: after deploy, we should run a quick backfill filter to remove the spurious rows from the last 36h before invoice finalize.
sam: we'll run a grouped dedupe: group by req_id,fingerprint,tenant,keep the one with served==true and highest timestamp.
ellie: careful: some customers legitimately hit both pools (e.g., ensemble calls). need to cross-check by model name difference (open-7b vs open-7b-fallback have same base in our naming scheme). use exact model_id comparison, and only dedupe when model_ids differ by the string "-fallback" suffix.
raj: logging action items: 1) temporary ingest filter (kevin), 2) backfill dedupe job (sam + maria), 3) longer-term: change route-resolver to emit audit as metadata-only to trace() not metering (tess + eng-runtime).
kevin: will open PR for ingest filter and tag it hotfix/billing-2026-03-23.
tess: I'll own the route-resolver change — drop metering flag in next minor release and add e2e tests to ensure no billable duplicate.
maria: thanks all. once hotfix lands, I'll re-run invoice preview and ping finance.
kevin: deployed to staging, running smoke now.
maria: smoke looks good — staging preview metric delta gone.
ops-bot: deploy completed by kevin at 2026-03-23T15:18Z :white_check_mark:
raj: moving to post-mortem doc. include timeline + sample events + queries used for backfill. also include decisions: keep observability but separate audit vs billable lanes.
tess: agreed. I'll add a test that simulates rapid fallback + retry to ensure the ingestion filter doesn't over-dedupe.
maria: tagging finance for final check: @finance-team please review invoice preview after backfill.
finance-team: ack, will review once you ping.
